about: SAMPLE DATA: invented daily flights of invented airlines, for the Disruption Recovery demo only. Not a real timetable.
Airlines (all fictional): IJ IndiJet, MJ Marjan Air, DA Dunes Air, DN Dilmun Air.
Read by the backend's SampleScheduleProvider, which offers direct flights and one-stop routes between them.
'departs' is local time at 'from', 'arrives' local time at 'to', 'arrivalDayOffset' = days later (0 = same day).
Time zones come from airport-rules.json. Every flight runs every day. fareInr = a SAMPLE one-way fare in rupees.
Seats are never known here: options from this file always show 'availability unknown'.
